### Credo's Toucan PCIe® Retimer Achieves PCI Express® Compliance and Joins PCI Express® 6.x Integrators List


August 31, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/511065572/files/doc_news/Credos-Toucan-PCIe-Retimer-Achieves-PCI-Express-Compliance-and-Joins-PCI-Express-6-x-Integrators-List-2026.pdf)


SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2F&esheet=54596404&newsitemid=20260831962360&lan=en-US&anchor=Credo+Technology+Group+Holding+Ltd&index=1&md5=e2cb825db7a4d8a469e34e1c2703f67f) (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, today announced that its Toucan Gen6x16 PCI Express® (PCIe®) retimer has successfully achieved PCI-SIG® 6.x retimer compliance at 64.0 GT/s and is now listed on the PCI-SIG Integrators List.


Credo's Toucan Gen6x16 PCI Express® (PCIe®) retimer has successfully achieved PCI-SIG® 6.x retimer compliance at 64.0 GT/s and is now listed on the PCI-SIG Integrators List.


**Key points:**


- Credo's Toucan Gen6x16 PCIe retimer successfully completed PCI-SIG 6.x retimer compliance testing at the recent PCI-SIG Compliance Workshop which concluded on July 31.
- Toucan is now listed on the PCI-SIG Integrators List, giving customers added confidence in standards-based PCIe 6.0 deployment.
- The compliance milestone validates Toucan across electrical compliance, interoperability, and expanded PCIe 6.0 retimer protocol requirements.
- Toucan combines PCIe 6.0 performance with DSP-based SerDes, low-power operation and deep diagnostics through PILOT software.


**Purpose-Built for Next-Gen Platforms**


Toucan retimers address integration challenges in AI, HPC, and accelerated compute environments with:


- PCIe 6.0 technology-compatible interoperability
- Low-power design for dense accelerator platforms
- Advanced debug and diagnostics through award-winning PILOT tool
- Architecture aligned with PCIe 7.0 technology roadmaps


“As AI infrastructure scales from individual servers to rack-scale and cluster-scale architectures, the role of PCIe architecture connectivity becomes increasingly important," said Vishal Shah, Vice President of Product at Credo. “Achieving PCIe 6.0 specification compliance and inclusion on the PCI-SIG Integrators List validates the ability of Credo’s PCIe retimer to deliver the signal integrity, interoperability, diagnostics, and power efficiency required by next-generation AI systems. This milestone gives customers confidence that Toucan is ready for production deployment in the most demanding accelerated computing environments.”


“We congratulate Credo on achieving PCI-SIG 6.x compliance for its Toucan retimers,” said Al Yanes, PCI-SIG President and Chairperson. “Industry collaboration and adherence to open standards are essential to advancing the PCI Express technology ecosystem.”


**Key Customer Benefits**


- PCIe 6.0 specification x16 readiness for AI, HPC, cloud, and accelerated compute platforms.
- Reduced integration and qualification risk through standards-based validation.
- Faster platform bring-up and root-cause debug using PILOT diagnostics and telemetry.
- Reliable operation across complex high-speed topologies and high-loss channels.
- Low-power design for dense accelerator and server environments.


The successful completion of PCI-SIG 6.x retimer testing underscores Credo's continued execution in high-speed connectivity and reinforces Toucan as a key building block for reliable PCIe 6.0 technology deployment in modern AI infrastructure.


To learn more about Credo’s PCIe retimer solutions, visit[https://credosemi.com/products/pcie/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fpcie%2F&esheet=54596404&newsitemid=20260831962360&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fcredosemi.com%2Fproducts%2Fpcie%2F&index=2&md5=063197e6ab457ec08ebd3daed8b3272b) .


**About Credo**


Credo’s mission is to transform connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions. Our high-speed copper and optical interconnect technologies deliver industry-leading power and performance from chip to cluster to meet the ever-expanding data infrastructure demands of AI.


Our vertically integrated connectivity portfolio is comprised of our flagship purple ZeroFlap (ZF) Active Electrical Cables (AECs) and ZF optical transceivers; optical components including silicon photonics-based photonic integrated circuits (SiPho PICs) and DSPs; OmniConnect AI memory and chip-to-chip interconnect; and retimers for Ethernet and PCIe—supported by our PILOT diagnostic and analytics software platform. Credo innovations enable our customers to connect the systems that connect the world.

**About PCI-SIG**


PCI-SIG is the consortium that owns and manages PCI specifications as open industry standards. The organization defines industry standard I/O (input/output) specifications consistent with the needs of its members. Currently, PCI-SIG is comprised of over 1,000 companies. To join PCI-SIG, and for a list of the Board of Directors, visit[https://www.pcisig.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pcisig.com%2F&esheet=54596404&newsitemid=20260831962360&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pcisig.com%2F&index=5&md5=54fe26fdcf83c858f9d134d0cab65f88) .
